name: Star Trek: The Next Generation
description: The crew of the USS Enterprise-D explores the galaxy, seeking out new life and new civilizations.
setting: USS Enterprise-D, United Federation of Planets

episodes.title: Encounter at Farpoint
episodes.premise: The omnipotent Q puts humanity on trial as Captain Picard takes command of the Enterprise-D, and the crew must solve the mystery of Farpoint Station to prove humanity's worth.

episodes.title: Skin of Evil
episodes.premise: A malevolent oil-slick entity holds Troi hostage on a desolate planet and casually kills a senior crew member, proving that evil in the universe can be senseless and absolute.

episodes.title: The Measure of a Man
episodes.premise: Data faces a Starfleet tribunal to determine whether he is property or a person with rights, with Picard arguing for his freedom and Riker forced to argue against it.

episodes.title: Q Who
episodes.premise: Q flings the Enterprise across the galaxy to introduce them to the Borg — a cybernetic collective that cannot be reasoned with, outmatches them completely, and is heading toward Earth.

episodes.title: The Defector
episodes.premise: A Romulan admiral defects to the Federation claiming the Empire is about to launch an invasion, and Picard must determine if it's genuine intelligence or an elaborate trap.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Enterprise
episodes.premise: A time rift brings the Enterprise-C forward in time, creating a dark alternate timeline where the Federation is losing a war with the Klingons and Tasha Yar is still alive.

episodes.title: The Offspring
episodes.premise: Data creates a daughter android named Lal and fights to keep Starfleet from taking her away, but her rapid emotional development pushes her neural net past its limits.

episodes.title: The Best of Both Worlds, Part I
episodes.premise: The Borg arrive at Earth's doorstep and assimilate Captain Picard into Locutus, leaving Riker in command with an impossible choice as the fleet is decimated at Wolf 359.

episodes.title: The Best of Both Worlds, Part II
episodes.premise: Riker must rescue Picard from the Borg Cube and use his assimilated captain's link to the collective to find a way to destroy the ship before it reaches Earth.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.premise: Picard returns to his family vineyard in France to recover from his assimilation, confronting his brother and finally breaking down over what the Borg did to him.

episodes.title: The Drumhead
episodes.premise: A visiting admiral's investigation into a security breach turns into a McCarthyist witch hunt aboard the Enterprise, and Picard must stand against the paranoia consuming Starfleet.

episodes.title: Darmok
episodes.premise: Picard is stranded on a planet with an alien captain whose species communicates entirely through mythological metaphor, and they must learn to understand each other before a beast kills them both.

episodes.title: Cause and Effect
episodes.premise: The Enterprise is caught in a time loop, destroyed in a collision every few hours, with the crew experiencing deja vu and finding cryptic clues from their previous iterations.

episodes.title: I, Borg
episodes.premise: The crew rescues a lone Borg drone and Picard plans to use him as a weapon to destroy the collective, but the drone develops individuality and Picard faces a moral crisis.

episodes.title: The Inner Light
episodes.premise: A alien probe renders Picard unconscious and he lives an entire lifetime as a man on a dying world — marriage, children, grandchildren — in just 25 minutes of real time.

episodes.title: Chain of Command, Part I
episodes.premise: Picard is sent on a covert mission into Cardassian territory and captured, beginning a brutal interrogation where his torturer insists there are five lights when there are four.

episodes.title: Chain of Command, Part II
episodes.premise: Picard endures escalating physical and psychological torture by Gul Madred while a new captain restructures the Enterprise, and Picard must hold onto his identity or break completely.

episodes.title: Tapestry
episodes.premise: Q gives a dying Picard the chance to relive and change a reckless moment from his youth, only to discover that without his mistakes he becomes a timid, unremarkable officer.

episodes.title: Frame of Mind
episodes.premise: Riker loses his grip on reality, shifting between performing in a play about an asylum and actually being a patient in one, unable to determine which world is real.

episodes.title: Gambit, Part I
episodes.premise: Picard is presumed dead and Riker tracks the pirates responsible, only to find Picard alive and undercover among them in a scheme involving ancient Vulcan artifacts.

episodes.title: The Pegasus
episodes.premise: Riker's former captain returns with orders to recover a lost ship hiding a Federation secret — an illegal cloaking device — forcing Riker to choose between old loyalties and Picard's trust.

episodes.title: Lower Decks
episodes.premise: Four junior officers navigate promotions, rivalries, and a classified mission, giving a rare view of life below the senior staff — ending with a devastating loss that Picard can only announce.

episodes.title: All Good Things...
episodes.premise: Q sends Picard shifting between three time periods where a spatial anomaly threatens to erase humanity from existence, and Picard must solve the paradox that he himself will create.
